mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to scrape: search (deviations matching `query`), userGallery (deviations in each user's gallery, newest first), userProfile (one profile item per user) or deviationUrls (one item per deviation URL, with tags).

query.title: Search query
query.description: Keyword(s) for mode search, e.g. dragon or cyberpunk city.

usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: DeviantArt usernames or profile URLs for modes userGallery and userProfile, e.g. wlop or https://www.deviantart.com/wlop.

deviationUrls.title: Deviation URLs
deviationUrls.description: Deviation page URLs for mode deviationUrls, e.g. https://www.deviantart.com/wlop/art/Nera2-1385671838.

maxItems.title: Max deviations
maxItems.description: Maximum deviations per search query or per user gallery. Each deviation is billed as one event. Not used for profiles or deviation URLs (each is always fetched).

includeMature.title: Include mature content
includeMature.description: Include deviations DeviantArt marks as mature. Off by default; mature items are then skipped and not billed. Only content DeviantArt shows to logged-out visitors is ever returned.

sinceDate.title: Published since
sinceDate.description: Only deviations published on or after this date, for monitoring. A date (2026-10-01) or relative time (7 days, 24 hours, 2 weeks). Galleries are newest first, so paging stops at the first older deviation; search is relevance-ranked, so results are only filtered.

includeTags.title: Fetch tags for search/gallery results
includeTags.description: Search and gallery pages don't list tags. Turn on to look up each deviation's tags (one extra request, about 1 s, per deviation). Deviation URLs always include tags.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Not needed normally; use Apify Proxy only if DeviantArt starts blocking very large runs.
